meta.title: Privacy Policy — Forcelis Group
meta.description: How Forcelis Group handles the personal data submitted through this website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This notice explains what this website collects, why, and what you can do about it. It covers the website only. Information handled inside a client engagement is governed by the agreement signed for that engagement.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: Forcelis Group is responsible for the personal data collected through this website. You can reach us at the address below for anything in this notice.

sections.title: What is collected
body: Only what you type into the contact form: company, name, email, phone (optional), industry, company size, the topics you select, and your message.
The website does not ask for and should never be used to send financial credentials, tax portal passwords, card or bank account numbers, or official identification numbers.

sections.title: Why it is collected
body: To respond to your enquiry, to understand whether Forcelis can help, and to prepare a proposal if you ask for one. It is not used for anything else and it is not sold or rented.

sections.title: Who else sees it
body: The form submission is delivered by a third-party form provider, which processes it on our behalf solely to deliver the message. Beyond that, the information is seen only by the people at Forcelis handling your enquiry.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: This website sets no advertising or tracking cookies.

If you change language using the switcher, your choice is stored locally in your own browser so the site can open in that language next time. It is never sent to a server and you can clear it by clearing your browser data.
If web analytics is enabled, it is listed here before it is turned on. As of the date of this notice, no analytics service is active on this site.

sections.title: How long it is kept
body: Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to respond and, if a relationship follows, for as long as that relationship requires. If you ask us to delete your data and there is no legal reason to keep it, we delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct, delete or object to the processing of your personal data, and to withdraw the consent you gave. Write to the address below and we will respond.
Under Mexican data protection law these are known as ARCO rights.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
body: If this notice changes, the updated version is published on this page with a new date.

meta.title: Terms of Service — Forcelis Group
meta.description: Terms governing the use of the Forcelis Group website.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of this website. They do not govern any service Forcelis provides to a client; that is set out in the agreement signed for the engagement.

sections.title: Purpose of this website
body: This website describes what Forcelis Group does. It is informational. Nothing here is an offer, a commitment to provide services on particular terms, or professional advice you should act on without a conversation about your specific situation.

sections.title: Illustrative figures
body: Every dashboard, score and metric shown on this site is illustrative and labelled as such. The figures do not describe any real company, are not benchmarks, and should not be used as a reference point for any decision.

sections.title: Scope of what Forcelis does
body: Forcelis provides analysis and advisory services. It does not issue tax opinions, does not determine tax positions, and does not replace the judgment of a licensed accountant or auditor. Where a matter requires a formal professional opinion, we will say so.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The content, design, wordmark and name of this site belong to Forcelis Group. You may read, quote with attribution, and share links. You may not reproduce the site or present its content as your own.

sections.title: Availability
body: The site is provided as it is. We aim to keep it accurate and available, but we do not guarantee that it will be free of errors or uninterrupted.

sections.title: Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States.
